mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE role='管理员' AND status='正常'
SELECT u.uid,u.role,u.status,COUNT(p.pid) AS workCount FROM user u LEFT JOIN pwork p ON p.uid=u.uid WHERE u.uid IN #{uid} GROUP BY u.uid,u.role,u.status
SELECT uid,uname AS nickname,avatar,bio,role,status,pnum, DATE_FORMAT(uct,'%Y-%m-%dT%H:%i:%s+08:00') AS createdAt FROM user ORDER BY uid ASC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT uid FROM user FORCE INDEX (PRIMARY) WHERE role='管理员' AND status='正常' ORDER BY uid ASC FOR UPDATE
SELECT uid,role,status FROM user WHERE uid=#{uid} FOR UPDATE
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pwork WHERE uid=#{uid}
SELECT pid FROM pwork WHERE uid=#{uid} ORDER BY pid ASC FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE user SET status=#{status} WHERE uid=#{uid}
UPDATE pwork SET wstatus='隐藏' WHERE uid=#{uid} AND wstatus='展示'
